design_rules: Implement one first-party generic numeric policy with traits/associated types/constants; encode ABI/platform variation as explicit parameters, not cloned datatype functions.
Keep source compatibility safe predicate distinct from exact payload representability and same_value kernel check.
Numeric kernels retain declared precision; no widen-compute-narrow runtime stand-in.
Custom finite/unknown runtime callback interfaces may require erased plugin state at interop boundary; keep numeric throughput dispatch statically typed where possible.
Phase-specific reference suppression can become an internal typed diagnostic plus externally equivalent False/absent outcome; never create a new caller error or globally clear errors.
NumPy C source is a reference oracle only; no foreign NumPy/JAX runtime or architecture substitution.
Public C/custom dtype/ctypes operations remain admitted. First-party functional-equivalent ABI design is pending concrete implementation ADR, not permission to silently exclude them.
